body.x: GYEONGGI, Korea (AVING Special Report on 'KES 2007') -- <Visual News> Samsung presented Giorgio Armani-Samsung mobile phone during KES 2007, which is the first jointly developed product of the two companies’ strategic alliance. This 10.5mm-thick phone features 3M camera, full touch screen with CROIX UI, Bluetooth capability, and etc. It is scheduled to be launched starting from November in Europe market.
